claims.claim_ar: الالتفات بالمخاطبة: النداء المباشر للمؤمنين (يا أيها الذين آمنوا) - تحول اللفظ إلى مخاطبة مقصودة
claims.claim_en: Iltifat (shift to direct address): the verse turns to address the believers directly ('O you who believe'), shifting the discourse into an explicit vocative mode.
claims.rhetorical_effect: يشد انتباه المخاطَب ويزيد الإحساس بالمسؤولية والوجوب الأخلاقي

claims.claim_ar: صيغة أمر ونهي/حث: الفعل الأمر في «اتقوا» وتوازيه مع أوامر النهي والحث في التعليقات النبوية (ائتمروا بالمعروف، وتناهوا عن المنكر)
claims.claim_en: Imperative / enjoining utterance (ijab/inshā'): the use of the imperative 'اتقوا' functions as a direct command/exhortation, paralleled in the reported prophetic admonitions ('consult on enjoining good and forbidding wrong').
claims.needs_review_reason: Mapping the reported exhortation formula in the tafsir to the verse's speech-act label (ijab_inshaa) is interpretive and may need corroboration from rhetorical-theory sources.
claims.rhetorical_effect: يحَفِّز على التقوى والالتزام العملي؛ يزيد إحساس الوجوب والالتزام لدى المخاطَبين

claims.claim_ar: الإيجاز/الاقتصاد في العبارة ووجود قراءات بديلة (يُؤْتُونَ ما آتَوْا / يأتون ما أتوا) يدل على لياقة اقتصادية في التعبير البلاغي
claims.claim_en: Ijaaz (conciseness): the phrasing and the attested variant readings ('يُؤْتُونَ ما آتَوْا' vs. 'يأتون ما أتوا') reflect concision and economy in expression, a rhetorical brevity.
claims.needs_review_reason: Claim rests on commentary about variant readings and their rhetorical significance; may require philological verification.
claims.rhetorical_effect: يوفر بلاغة موجزة تُكسب الكلام قوة وتركيزاً، ويُبرز التناقض السلوكي لدى المخاطبين

warnings: Provided source chunks are from Zamakhshari and Tabari; the requested authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) are not present in the chunks. Claims are drawn only from the supplied chunks.

Some mappings from tafsir comments to the specified device taxonomy (e.g., labeling exhortatory formulas as 'ijab_inshaa' or treating variant readings as 'ijaaz') are interpretive and flagged in needs_review_reason.

Only substrings actually present in the supplied chunks were used as source_quote_ar; other obvious rhetorical features of the verse that are not explicitly discussed in these chunks were not claimed.
